sentences.en: The value can be either an integer value specifying a pre-defined line style, or a two-element vector specifying a stippling pattern.

sentences.en: Now, using a stippling action, blend the paint together until it is almost a uniform color.

sentences.en: Venetian plaster, granite paint or stippling can all texturize your walls beautifully.

sentences.en: An up and down stippling motion is the most popular way to apply paint.
